userStories.title: Vault Creation
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to create a new Knowledge Vault with a name and description so that I can organize sources around a specific research topic
acceptanceCriteria: User can create vault via POST /api/v1/vaults/
Required fields: name (max 255 chars)
Optional fields: description (text)
Creator is automatically assigned OWNER role
Response includes vault ID, timestamps, and creator info
Audit log entry created: vault.created

userStories.title: Vault Ownership Transfer
userStories.description: As a vault owner, I want to transfer ownership to another existing member so that I can delegate vault management responsibilities
acceptanceCriteria: Owner can PATCH /api/v1/vaults/{id}/members/{user_id}/ with role: 'OWNER'
System validates target user is already a vault member
Previous owner's role automatically downgraded to CONTRIBUTOR
Only one OWNER allowed per vault (enforced by signal)
Audit log entry created: membership.role_changed

userStories.title: Member Invitation (Hybrid Flow)
userStories.description: As a vault owner, I want to add existing platform users directly or invite external users via email so that I can quickly onboard collaborators
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/vaults/{id}/members/ with user_id or email
If user_id provided: immediate membership creation (no confirmation)
If email provided and user exists: immediate membership creation + notification
If email provided and user not found: create pending invitation (future phase)
Default role: CONTRIBUTOR (can override with role param)
Audit log entry created: membership.added

userStories.title: Role Management
userStories.description: As a vault owner, I want to update member roles between OWNER/CONTRIBUTOR/VIEWER so that I can adjust permissions as project needs evolve
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/v1/vaults/{id}/members/{user_id}/ with new role
Only owners can change roles
Cannot downgrade last owner (validation error)
Role weights enforced: OWNER=3, CONTRIBUTOR=2, VIEWER=1
Audit log entry created: membership.role_changed

userStories.title: Member Removal
userStories.description: As a vault owner, I want to remove members from the vault so that I can revoke access when collaborations end
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE /api/v1/vaults/{id}/members/{user_id}/
Only owners can remove members
Cannot remove last owner (validation error)
Member loses all vault access immediately
Audit log entry created: membership.removed

userStories.title: Vault Listing with Role Filtering
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to see all vaults I own or am a member of, filtered by my role, so that I can quickly navigate to relevant projects
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/vaults/?role=OWNER&is_archived=false
Pagination: page and page_size (default 20)
Filters: role (OWNER/CONTRIBUTOR/VIEWER), is_archived (true/false)
Response includes vault metadata + user's role + member count
Excludes vaults where user has no membership

userStories.title: Vault Archive & Restore
userStories.description: As a vault owner, I want to archive completed vaults and restore them later so that I can declutter active projects without losing data
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/vaults/{id}/archive/ sets is_archived=True
Archived vaults enter read-only mode: all members can view, no create/update/delete
POST /api/v1/vaults/{id}/restore/ sets is_archived=False
Only owners can archive/restore
Audit log entries: vault.archived, vault.restored

userStories.title: Permission-Based Access Control
userStories.description: As a system, I want to enforce role-based permissions on all vault operations so that users can only perform actions appropriate to their role
acceptanceCriteria: Custom DRF permissions: IsVaultOwner, IsVaultContributor, IsVaultMember
Permissions applied: Create vault (Authenticated), Update/Delete/Archive (IsVaultOwner), Add/Remove members (IsVaultOwner), View vault (IsVaultMember)
403 Forbidden returned for unauthorized actions
Failed permission checks logged in audit trail (optional)

userStories.title: Audit Trail for Research Integrity
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to view a complete history of vault changes so that I can verify research integrity and collaboration history
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/vaults/{id}/audit-logs/
Logged events: vault.created, vault.updated, vault.archived, vault.restored, membership.added, membership.role_changed, membership.removed
Each entry includes: timestamp, actor (user), action, vault_id, metadata (JSON)
Audit logs are immutable (no update/delete endpoints)
Ordered by created_at DESC

userStories.title: Create Vault, VaultMembership, and AuditLog Models
userStories.description: Define Django models for Vault, VaultMembership (with role enum), and AuditLog with proper constraints and indexes
acceptanceCriteria: Vault model created with name, description, owner FK, is_archived, timestamps
VaultMembership model with vault FK, user FK, role (OWNER/CONTRIBUTOR/VIEWER), added_at, added_by
RoleChoices enum with OWNER=3, CONTRIBUTOR=2, VIEWER=1 weights
AuditLog model with vault FK, actor FK, action, metadata (JSON), created_at
Unique constraint: (vault, user) in VaultMembership
CHECK constraint: at least one OWNER per vault
Indexes: vault.owner+is_archived, membership.vault+role, auditlog.vault+created_at
Database migrations generated and applied

userStories.title: Create Serializers for Vaults and Memberships
userStories.description: Implement VaultSerializer, VaultMembershipSerializer, and AuditLogSerializer with computed fields
acceptanceCriteria: VaultSerializer includes owner_username, member_count, user_role computed fields
VaultMembershipSerializer includes username, email from user
AuditLogSerializer for read-only audit log responses
Validation: name max 255 chars, description optional
Serializers properly handle nested relationships

userStories.title: Implement Custom DRF Permissions
userStories.description: Create IsVaultOwner, IsVaultContributor, IsVaultMember permission classes with role weight checks
acceptanceCriteria: IsVaultOwner checks user has OWNER role (weight=3)
IsVaultContributor checks user has CONTRIBUTOR or higher (weight≥2)
IsVaultMember checks user has any vault membership (weight≥1)
Permissions use get_role_weight() method from VaultMembership
has_object_permission() implemented for all classes

userStories.title: Create VaultViewSet with CRUD Operations
userStories.description: Implement VaultViewSet with create, retrieve, update, destroy, list, archive, and restore actions
acceptanceCriteria: VaultViewSet extends ModelViewSet
create: auto-assign owner to request.user
list: filter by user's memberships, support role and is_archived query params
retrieve/update/destroy: enforce permissions (IsVaultOwner for mutations, IsVaultMember for read)
Custom actions: archive (POST), restore (POST) with IsVaultOwner permission
Pagination: PageNumberPagination with page_size=20
Filtering: DjangoFilterBackend for is_archived

userStories.title: Create VaultMembershipViewSet for Member Management
userStories.description: Implement nested VaultMembershipViewSet under /vaults/{id}/members/ with add, update role, remove actions
acceptanceCriteria: Nested under VaultViewSet using drf-nested-routers or manual routing
list: IsVaultMember permission
create: IsVaultOwner permission, accepts user_id or email
update/partial_update: IsVaultOwner permission, validates role changes
destroy: IsVaultOwner permission, validates not removing last owner
perform_create: set added_by to request.user

userStories.title: Implement Django Signals for Audit Logging
userStories.description: Create signal handlers for vault and membership mutations to auto-generate audit log entries
acceptanceCriteria: post_save signal on Vault: log vault.created and vault.updated
post_save signal on VaultMembership: log membership.added
pre_save signal on VaultMembership: log membership.role_changed (compare old vs new role)
post_delete signal on VaultMembership: log membership.removed
Archive/restore actions manually create audit logs in views
Signals registered in apps.py ready() method
Metadata includes relevant changeset details (user_id, role, etc.)

userStories.title: Create AuditLogViewSet (Read-Only)
userStories.description: Implement read-only viewset for viewing vault audit logs
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/vaults/{id}/audit-logs/
Nested under VaultViewSet
IsVaultMember permission
Ordered by created_at DESC
Pagination enabled (default page_size=50)
No create/update/delete actions (read-only)

userStories.title: Configure URL Routing for Vaults
userStories.description: Create apps/vaults/urls.py with DRF router and nested routes for memberships and audit logs
acceptanceCriteria: DefaultRouter for VaultViewSet at /api/v1/vaults/
Nested routes for memberships at /api/v1/vaults/{id}/members/
Nested route for audit logs at /api/v1/vaults/{id}/audit-logs/
Custom actions (archive, restore) properly routed
URLs included in config/urls.py
URL patterns properly named for reverse lookups

userStories.title: Add Auto-Owner Membership Creation Signal
userStories.description: Create signal to automatically add vault creator as OWNER in VaultMembership on vault creation
acceptanceCriteria: post_save signal on Vault model
Only triggers on created=True
Creates VaultMembership with user=vault.owner, role=OWNER, added_by=vault.owner
Signal registered in apps.py ready() method
Prevents duplicate memberships (use get_or_create)

userStories.title: Implement Ownership Transfer Logic
userStories.description: Add validation and automatic role downgrade when transferring vault ownership
acceptanceCriteria: When VaultMembership role changed to OWNER, find existing owner
Downgrade previous owner to CONTRIBUTOR automatically
Implemented in VaultMembership.save() override or pre_save signal
Ensure only one OWNER exists per vault at all times
Transaction wrapped to prevent race conditions

userStories.title: Add Archive Read-Only Enforcement Middleware
userStories.description: Create middleware or permission mixin to enforce read-only mode on archived vaults
acceptanceCriteria: Check vault.is_archived in permission classes
Allow GET/HEAD/OPTIONS on archived vaults
Block POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on archived vaults (except restore action)
Return 403 Forbidden with message 'Vault is archived (read-only)'
Applied to all vault-related views (sources, annotations, etc. in future)

userStories.title: Write Comprehensive Test Suite for Vaults
userStories.description: Create unit and integration tests for vault models, permissions, views, and signals
acceptanceCriteria: Model tests: unique constraint (vault, user), CHECK constraint (at least one owner), role weights
Permission tests: IsVaultOwner, IsVaultContributor, IsVaultMember with various roles
View tests: vault CRUD, member add/update/remove, archive/restore, role filtering
Signal tests: auto-owner creation, audit log generation, ownership transfer
Edge cases: last owner deletion blocked, archived vault write blocked, non-member access denied
Test coverage >90% for apps/vaults/

userStories.title: Update Documentation and Manual Verification Checklists
userStories.description: Document vault API endpoints and add manual verification tasks to .planning/
acceptanceCriteria: API documentation with request/response examples for all 10 endpoints
OpenAPI/Swagger schema updated
MANUAL_VERIFICATION.md updated with vault testing checklist
USER_SETUP.md updated (no new env vars needed)
Django admin interface configured for Vault, VaultMembership, AuditLog
README.md updated with vault system overview
